nodes.name: Solution Growth of ZIF-67
nodes.procedure: The well-aligned leaf-like zeolitic imidazolate framework (ZIF-67) arrays were first in situ grown on carbon cloth through a typical facile solution method.
nodes.source_text: the well-aligned leaf-like zeolitic imidazolate framework (ZIF-67) arrays were first in situ grown on carbon cloth through a typical facile solution method.

nodes.name: Ion Exchange to NiCo-LDHs
nodes.procedure: The NiCo-LDHs hierarchical nanocages were obtained by the ion exchange/etching process between ZIF-67 and Ni2+ ions, where out-diffused Co2+ co-deposited with in-diffused Ni2+ ion during hydrolysis to form thin layered LDH hierarchical shells.
nodes.source_text: Then, the NiCo-LDHs hierarchical nanocages could be obtained by the ion exchange/etching process between ZIF-67 and Ni2+ ions ... to form thin layered LDH hierarchical shells.

nodes.name: Electrodeposition and Calcination of Eu2O3-NiCo
nodes.procedure: Eu2O3 was immobilized and converted to Eu2O3-NiCo arrays on carbon cloth by the electrodeposition of Eu ions at a current density of 10 mAcm-2 followed by a calcination process in H2 atmosphere at 600 C.

unit_operations.name: Electrodeposition
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: the Eu ions are successfully introduced into NiCo-LDHs ... the sample with Eu-deposition at 10 mAcm-2 exhibits the best HER performance.

unit_operations.name: Calcination
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: subsequent calcination process. ... subsequent annealing in H2 atmosphere ... Eu2O3-NiCo obtained at 600 C exhibits the optimal HER activity.

nodes.source_text: Eu2O3 was immobilized and converted to Eu2O3-NiCo arrays on carbon cloth by the electrodeposition and subsequent calcination process. ... 600 C exhibits the optimal HER activity ... Eu-deposition at 10 mAcm-2 exhibits the best HER performance.

nodes.name: Synthesis of NiCo
nodes.procedure: NiCo sample was fabricated with a similar procedure to that of Eu2O3-NiCo but without the Eu electrodeposition, using calcination in H2 atmosphere at 600 C.

nodes.description: HER performance evaluation in alkaline medium (1.0 M KOH)
nodes.source_text: The electrocatalytic HER performance... was assessed by different indexes in N2 saturated 1.0 mKOH solution with a standard three-electrode system... Eu2O3-NiCo shows low overpotentials of only 60 and 150 mV at the 10 and 50 mAcm−2... Tafel slope of 76.0 mVdec−1... Cdl value of 21.8 mFcm−2... TOF values of 0.51 and 1.59 s−1... Ea value of 32.25 kJ mol−1... Faraday efficiency... matches well with the theoretical value... 2000 cycles of cyclic voltammetry (CV) test.
the Eu2O3-NiCo also presents good oxygen evolution reaction (OER) property with a low overpotential of 320 mV at 10 mAcm−2
